To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the design and fabrication of an 80 ns 32 bit RISC in GaAs using enhancementmode JFETs is feasible.

(1) the GaAs technology is capable of supporting the implementation of a high-performance RISC microprocessor; (2) the GaAs RISC microprocessor is capable of operating at a clock rate of at least 200 MHz and a power consumption level of approximately 1.5 W, and (3) a high-performance microprocessor implemented in GaAs can be designed and fabricated using a standard CMOS design flow and fabrication process.

(1) GaAs can be used to fabricate a high performance microprocessor, (2) the GaAs process is capable of fabricating a high quality microprocessor, and (3) GaAs can compete with silicon as a microprocessor fabrication material.
